title: Synopsys to Acquire SpringSoft
主要内容: Synopsys, Inc. (Nasdaq:SNPS) has signed a definitive agreement to acquire SpringSoft (TAIEX:2473), a global supplier of specialized IC design software headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of fiscal 2013, with a gross value of approximately US$406 million (NT$12.2 billion). The acquisition aims to enhance Synopsys' verification technology and custom implementation tools by integrating SpringSoft's physical design technology and teams. This move is intended to accelerate innovation and automation in semiconductor design and strengthen Synopsys' presence in Asia, Europe, and the U.S., addressing stagnant areas in IC design.
